headline: Singapore Updates Insolvency Framework to Support Corporate Restructuring
summary: Singapore is updating its restructuring and insolvency regulations to ensure judicial management acts as an effective business rehabilitation tool rather than an automatic precursor to liquidation.
why: Singapore has actively modernized its legal architecture to compete with London and New York as a primary jurisdiction for cross-border debt restructurings.

impacts.name: Singapore
impacts.why: Clearer rehabilitation pathways improve creditor recovery rates and strengthen Singapore's insolvency hub status.
